verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation ships its own isolation tooling for test environments: Boxes for one-click virtual machines, preinstalled container tools for creating and running containers, and a Container Toolbox subvariant. Together these give a user a separate place to experiment away from their main system. The evidence is marketing-level only, though, and never frames these as data-isolated sandboxes for agent or AI testing. missing for 10: explicit documentation of isolation guarantees separating sandbox from host/production data, agent-oriented sandbox workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of using Boxes/Toolbox as test sandboxes.
